architecture_development_comparison.selection_basis: Development-year LOYO mean nMAE only; selection frozen before final-year predictions

bias_correction_basis: Negative sample-weighted mean prediction bias from development-year LOYO folds only; excludes test year and held-out schedule family.

split_manifest.rule: latest complete year shared by all sources = untouched test year; earlier years = LOYO development pool; newer source-only years excluded from fitting; family 'irregular' held out from fitting
split_manifest.test_weather_note: Weather years match prior release checks; this release uses newly executed schedules, never fitted. No parameters are selected from final-year or held-out-family results.

pilot_note: Discovery and published pilot weather are pooled. Mapped planning calendars retain original weather-year split assignments; metrics measure simulated yield, not field calibration.

domain.validated_weather_basis: Exact weather input hashes evaluated in the untouched test-year release check; model fitting excludes that year. Soil and irrigation ranges remain fitting-only.
